models.licenseReview: Repository MIT; trained on CelebAMask-HQ whose agreement limits the dataset and derived data to non-commercial research. Weight commercial/redistribution rights are not cleared; not redistributed by LumaLab.

models.output: First output: 1x1x320x320 sky sigmoid matte; Float16 converted to Float32 at C ABI

models.input: Float32 NCHW image 1x3x512x512 RGB/255; mask 1x1x512x512 binary1=remove
models.processing: Aspect-preserving resize with reflected context padding; conservative max reduction of mask; bilinear native ROI reconstruction; only mask-positive RGB replaced and original alpha retained. Caller applies feather/opacity once.

models.license: Apache-2.0 (Google official Model Card and conversion publisher)
models.input: Float32 NHWC 1x256x256x3, RGB/255; stretch, no ImageNet normalization
models.output: Float32 NHWC 1x256x256x6 logits, transposed to planar by the macOS adapter
models.limitations: Selfie framing model; small/distant people, occlusion and fine edges may need manual refinement. Full image plus detected-person crops are combined; optional face parser refines faces.

limitations: Face location currently uses an Apple Vision adapter; semantic parsing uses the bundled ONNX model.
Subject/background and people use Apple Vision adapters in this macOS release. Saved coverage remains portable.
Sky model inference resolution is 320x320; fine trees/hair edges may need brush refinement.
No image uploads, telemetry, runtime model downloads, or Adobe model weights.
LaMa reconstructs selected content from surrounding context; results may invent incorrect structures or become soft for large ROIs.
LaMa inference is 512x512 and CPU-based in this build; it is a content-removal complement, not a Camera Raw performance or quality match.
